purpose: Define canonical change control and audit evidence for AccessCore policies so authorization changes are reviewable, attributable and cannot silently alter active rights.

owns: AccessCore Policy Change and Audit semantics

topics.name: AccessCore Policy Change and Audit
topics.purpose: Define canonical change control and audit evidence for AccessCore policies so authorization changes are reviewable, attributable and cannot silently alter active rights.

semantics.change_rule: Policy create/update/remove is an explicit canonical change operation.
semantics.authority_rule: Policy mutation requires explicit policy-administration authority.
semantics.validation_rule: Candidate policy validates identity, target refs, rule precedence and lockout/safety constraints before activation.
semantics.audit_rule: Change records actor identity, affected policy/resource, semantic diff, time/run identity and result.
semantics.activation_rule: Validated policy change becomes active through explicit apply/reload semantics.
semantics.rollback_rule: Previous accepted policy version/snapshot remains traceable for rollback/recovery where policy supports it.
semantics.secret_rule: Audit records do not expose credential secrets.

invariants.rule: AccessCore decisions are explicit policy evaluations over identity, resource and operation context; authentication assurance, visibility and ownership never silently become authorization.

hard_gates.condition: policy edit takes effect solely through UI state

references.purpose: Policy mutation follows canonical change control.
Validated policy may activate through reload/apply semantics.

prose.summary: Define canonical change control and audit evidence for AccessCore policies so authorization changes are reviewable, attributable and cannot silently alter active rights.
